_comment: THE SCORE AND THE ROOM, added in the port — the prototype had neither, and neither did this until Settings grew the two sliders that drive them. Same shape as sounds.json and the same promise: a missing file is silence, never an error, so the game runs at any point between no music and all of it. `status` is placeholder | wip | final; every track that ships today is a synthesised stand-in (tests/gen_sounds.py) and is meant to be replaced — see docs/SOUND_GUIDE.md, which names the CC0 sources a stock track can come from. `loop` is what separates these from sounds.json: a cue plays until something else replaces it. `fade` is the crossfade in seconds. A cue with no file just does not play.

parlour.notes: The menu and everything outside a run. Slow, sparse, a room with the lamp on and nobody in it yet.

the_evening.notes: The map: the night's plan in front of you. Walking pace, a little expectant.

the_table.notes: A reading. Quietest of the three — somebody is talking over this and the cards are the event.

the_mayor.notes: The last half hour of the third night. The only track allowed to be uncomfortable.

after.notes: The end of a run, win or lose. What is left when the knocking stops.

rain.notes: The default room: rain on the window of a small house in bad weather. Under everything, all night.

fire.notes: The grate, for the hours indoors. Optional second layer under rain.
